correctness.rationale: Symmetric nonadjacency gives S contained in F^2(S); applying this both to S and to F(S), and using antitonicity, gives F^3=F. The target empty/full cycle therefore has basin consisting of the empty set and all total dominating sets. Switch each horizontal boundary matching between the two row labels and discard rungs. The closed neighborhood of (i,1-r) in the resulting graph is exactly the open neighborhood of (i,r) in the original graph. The row permutation after a circuit has parity n for the ordinary seam and n+1 for the Möbius seam, including the simple cubic n=3 cases. The no-000 trace has nonzero roots of X^3-X^2-X-1, and their negative pairwise products are the roots of Q=X^3-X^2+X+1. Thus D_n^2-D_(2n)=2(-1)^n v_n and the swapped parity gives the claimed -2v_n. The recurrence preserves oddness. Q is irreducible by the rational-root test and has discriminant -44; the only possible nontrivial abelian Galois subfield is Q(sqrt(-11)), with roots of unity only ±1. The ratio of the nonreal conjugate roots is neither +/-1 (distinctness and the real root in (-1,0)); it is therefore not a root of unity. Irrational rotation on each progression makes the dominant cosine exceed a fixed positive level and fall below its negative infinitely often. The exponentially growing basin is asymptotic to the square of the positive tribonacci root raised to n, giving the stated relative bound. The finite replay path (transfer n=3..40, exhaustive n=3..9) does not certify the Galois or asymptotic steps.
